g.text: Do not power amplifier from PoE board.
local GND bus: branches only, one trunk to common rail
local GND bus: branches only, one trunk to common rail
local GND bus: branches only, one trunk to common rail
local GND bus: branches only, one trunk to common rail
Controller: Waveshare ESP32-P4-POE-ETH / NH powered by PoE.
PoE powers ESP32 only; no lamp/audio load power from board.
Use INPUT_PULLUP: unpressed HIGH, pressed LOW.
Do not tie LED/lamp negatives together.
COMMON_GND is required for GPIO-controlled external loads.
All signal-crossing grounds must be common
5V_AUDIO_SERVO for any Simon audio module / amplifier
Do not power audio from the ESP32 PoE board
If using 5V lamps, use the master 5V_LED rail instead
Do not draw lamp/audio current from ESP32
